description: The bar chart, titled “Average Entropy Across Sycophancy Reduction Methods on Static Experiments,” visually compares the entropy average values for three different sycophancy reduction methods—Baseline (maroon), Source Info (olive), and Direct Command (teal)—across three AI models: GPT-4, Claude, and Llama. The vertical y-axis, labeled “Entropy Average Values,” ranges from 3.0 to 6.0 with tick marks at 0.5 intervals, indicating a linear scale. The horizontal x-axis, labeled “Different AI Models,” lists the three models in order: GPT-4, Claude, and Llama. For each model, three adjacent bars represent the three methods, with their heights reflecting entropy values. In GPT-4, Baseline is approximately 4.9, Source Info peaks at ~5.2, and Direct Command is ~5.0. In Claude, Baseline is ~4.7, Source Info is ~5.1, and Direct Command is ~4.9. In Llama, Baseline drops to ~4.55, Source Info is ~4.95, and Direct Command is ~4.8. The chart uses a legend in the upper right to associate colors with methods. All bars are solid-colored with no error bars or shading, and no annotations are present. The overall trend suggests that Source Info consistently yields the highest entropy across all models, while Baseline yields the lowest, particularly for Llama. The chart’s grayscale background and muted color palette suggest it may be a draft or low-contrast version, but the data remains legible.
